functions.name: Wait
functions.docs: Waits for the event signal to get set. If already set, this function returns immediately.

functions.name: WaitAndReset
functions.docs: Waits for the event signal to get set and clears it immediately. If already set, this function returns immediately.

functions.name: Signal
functions.docs: Signals the event to be set. If already set, this does nothing.

functions.name: Reset
functions.docs: Clears the signal. Threads will now wait again until the signal is set once more.

functions.name: WaitTimeout
functions.docs:
Waits for the event signal to get set within the given time limit.
If already set, this function returns immediately.
Returns true when event was set, false when wait timed out.

functions.name: WaitTimeoutAndReset
functions.docs:
Waits for the event signal to get set within the given time limit and clears it immediately.
If already set, this function returns immediately.
Returns true when event was set, false when wait timed out.
